message.content: {"verdict": "conflict", "citations": ["rbi-13141"], "confidence": 0.95, "rationale": "RBI directions require commercial banks to review the risk categorisation of accounts at least once every six months, whereas the bank's policy restricts this review to the time of periodic updation of KYC (which is every 2, 8, or 10 years), constituting a conflict by using a much weaker review frequency."}
